supervisor_sizing.entry: 2 tranches over ~10 weeks: half now, half after the 2026-12-02 Q2 FY27 print and Q3 guide
supervisor_sizing.overlap: GOOGL and META (their AI capex is Credo's revenue; ~35% of the portfolio already), TSLA (high-beta AI/momentum factor); AAPL only loosely
supervisor_sizing.reason: After fact-checking, the research target (12m) of $223.00 is ~48% above the round's $151.15 spot (allocation.json, 2026-10-26: 223.00 / 151.15 - 1 = 47.5%), but on a ~90%-vol name with 61% top-two customer concentration and a binary H2 ramp test on 2026-12-02. Liquidity is ample and the stock has been listed since 2022, with no lock-up overhang beyond 10b5-1 insider sales and DustPhotonics earn-out shares. The portfolio is already heavy in the hyperscalers whose capex drives Credo, so a cap of ~4% keeps a thesis-break loss (a close at $125, 17.3% below $151.15) near 0.7% of the portfolio (4% x 17.3% = 0.69%).

method: Suggested allocation from the cash to deploy: one joint solve over every name (optimize.py), run after combine.py.

risk_model.note: Annualized vol of the whole account (holdings + all suggested buys, rest in cash): blended vols, recalibrated factor-model correlations.
